sn3.9:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Tena kho pana samayena rañño Pasenadi-kosalassa mahā-yañño paccupaṭṭhito hoti || pañca ca usabha-satāni pañca ca vacchatara-satāni pañca ca vacchatarī-satāni pañca ca aja-satāni pañca ca urabbha-satāni thūṇūpanitāni honti yaññatthāya || Ye pi-ssa te honti dāsā ti vā pessā ti vā kammakarā ti vā te pi daṇḍa-tajjitā bhaya-tajjitā assumukhā rudamānā parikammāni karonti || ||
sn3.9:2.1: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū pubbaṇha-samayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Sāvatthiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃsu || Sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā paccabhattaṃ piṇḍapāta-paṭikkantā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkamiṃsu || Upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || Ekam antaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū Bhagavantam etad avocuṃ || || Idha bhante rañño Pasenadi-kosalassa mahā-yañño paccupaṭṭhito hoti || Pañca ca usabha-satāni pañca ca vacchatara-satāni pañca vacchatarī-satāni pañca ca urabbhasatāni thūṇūpanitāni honti yaññatthāya || || Ye pi-ssa te honti dāsā ti vā pessā ti vā kammakarā ti vā te pi daṇḍa-tajjitā bhaya-tajjitā assumukhā rudamānā parikammāni karontīti || ||
sn3.9:3.1: Atha kho Bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyam imā gāthayo abhāsi || ||
sn3.9:4.1: Assamedhaṃ purisamedhaṃ || sammāpāsaṃ vājapeyyaṃ || niraggaḷaṃ mahārambhā || na te honti mahapphalā || ||
sn3.9:5.1: ajeḷakā gāvo ca || vividhā yattha haññare || na tam sammaggatā yaññaṃ || upayanti mahesino || ||
sn3.9:6.1: Ye ca yaññā nirārambhā || yajanti anukūlaṃ sadā || ajeḷakā ca gāvo ca || vividhā n-ettha haññare || || etaṃ sammaggatā yaññaṃ || upayanti mahesino ||
sn3.9:7.1: etaṃ yajetha medhāvī || eso yañño mahapphalo || || etaṃ hi yajamānassa || seyyo hoti na pāpiyo || yañño ca vipulo hoti ||pasīdanti ca devatā ti || ||
